summary: Faz-6.1 + 6.2 Strategy Domain & Deterministic Kernel Contract testing complete. All 32 backend tests passed. Frontend /admin/strategies page fully functional with create/version/activate/archive flows and deterministic kernel evaluate. Bug fix applied: strategy_domain.py line 185 changed payload.symbol to context.symbol for non-existent version handling.
critical_code_review_comments: StrategyDefinition.code unique constraint + case-insensitive normalization working correctly
StrategyVersion immutable via SQLAlchemy event listener @event.listens_for(StrategyVersion, 'before_update')
Append-only behavior: same config creates new version because version_number increments
Activation pointer updates active_version_id + sets status='active'
Kernel determinism verified: same context -> same context_hash + decision_hash
Canonical JSON ordering: key order does not affect hash (sort_keys=True)
Validation errors return 200 + REJECT action (not HTTP 422)
Non-existent version returns 200 + REJECT with reason_code='strategy_version_not_found' (after bug fix)
seed_data_creation: Multiple strategy definitions and versions created during testing (codes: ui-test-*, test-strat-*, kernel-test-*, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Faz-6.1 + 6.2 Strategy Domain features fully tested. Key behaviors: (1) StrategyDefinition has unique code (case-insensitive), owner_type=admin, status=draft/active/archived, (2) StrategyVersion is immutable with auto-incrementing version_number and SHA-256 version_hash, (3) Activation updates active_version_id pointer and sets status=active, (4) Archive sets status=archived, (5) Registry returns only active strategies, (6) Kernel evaluate is deterministic (same context -> same hashes), (7) Canonical JSON ordering invariance verified, (8) Validation errors return typed REJECT (not 422), (9) Hash mismatch and non-existent version return REJECT. Frontend /admin/strategies page has all UI elements with data-testid attributes. Phase-6.3 runtime/event-bus NOT tested per scope.
